units: <cite ref="Chullin 10b:13">Ḥull. 10ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>עד אחד נאמן וכ׳</he> in matters of ritual the statement of one witness is sufficient.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 36a:10">Bekh. 36ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>עד מפי עד</he> a witness testifying to what he has heard from an eye-witness.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 26a:1">R. Hash. 26</cite>, a. e. <he>אין עד נעשה דיין</he> a witness in the case cannot act as judge.
<cite ref="Ketubot 21b:6">Keth. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>עד נעשה דיין</he> a witness may act as judge; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>עֵדִים</he>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 21b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>דיינים המכירין חתימות ידי ע׳</he> if the judges know (can identify) the signatures of the witnesses to a document.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 2:3">Ib. II, 3</cite> <he>הע׳ שאמרו וכ׳</he> if witnesses declare, this is our signature, but we have been forced &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 2:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>אם יש ע׳ וכ׳</he> if there is evidence that she was a married woman.—
Kidd. 48ᵃ, a. fr. עידֵי חתימה, ע׳ מסירה, v. כְּרַת; a. v. fr.—Trnsf. evidence, proof.
<cite ref="Shabbat 81a:7">Sabb. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>אם יש עליה עד</he> (euphem.) if there is an evidence (stain of excrements) on it.

B. Kam. 11ᵃ top (ref. to Ex. XXII, 12) יביא עד עורה Ar. (ed. אדורה, עדודה, v. אָדַר) he shall offer in evidence its hide.—Esp. a piece of cloth used by women for ascertaining their condition of cleanness or uncleanness.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 8:4">Nidd. VIII, 4</cite> <he>עד שהוא נתון וכ׳</he> if an examining rag (after use) has been put under the cushion &c.

<cite ref="Niddah 14b:67">Ib. 14ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 12a:12">12ᵃ</cite> <he>משל לשמש ועד וכ׳</he> to speak allegorically (euphemistically), the servant and the examiner stand by the side of the threshold &c. (v. <cite ref="U01541"><he>שַׁמָּשׁ</he></cite>).
Ib. זהו עֵדָן של צנועות (Ar. עֵידָן) this (special) rag is that of the chaste women; a. fr.—Pl. as ab. Ib. I, 7. Ib. II, 1; a. fr.
